rules: 1. Live name wins: query this.database<DbFinalEntitiesRow>('final_entities').where('final_entities.entity_ref', request.formerRef).select({ entityId: 'final_entities.entity_id' }).first(); when a row exists return { items: { type: 'object', entities: [null] } } without looking at claims. This check never uses the caller's credentials.
3. No claim: return { items: { type: 'object', entities: [null] } }.
4. Two claims: call this.logger.debug(`Refusing to resolve former entity ref ${request.formerRef}, it is claimed by more than one entity`) and return { items: { type: 'object', entities: [null] } }.
5. One claim: return this.entitiesBatch({ entityRefs: [claims[0].entityRef], filter: request.filter, credentials: request.credentials }).
6. Do not change entitiesBatch or any other existing method (NFR-1).

sites.rule: Chain .get('/entities/by-former-name/:kind/:namespace/:name', async (req, res) => { ... }) right after the by-name route, following rules 1 to 5 of this unit; the existing by-name and ancestry routes stay unchanged.

rules: 1. const { kind, namespace, name } = req.params; const formerRef = stringifyEntityRef({ kind, namespace, name });
2. const auditorEvent = await auditor.createEvent({ eventId: 'entity-fetch', request: req, meta: { queryType: 'by-former-name', entityRef: formerRef } });
3. In try: const { items } = await entitiesCatalog.entityByFormerRef({ formerRef, credentials: await httpAuth.credentials(req) }); then await auditorEvent?.success();

4. Then writeSingleEntityResponse(res, items, `No entity found that was formerly named '${name}', with kind '${kind}' in namespace '${namespace}'`); a denied or unresolved lookup therefore gives the same 404 as an unknown ref.
5. In catch: await auditorEvent?.fail({ error: err }); throw err;
